name: Craftsman S180
blurb: Oregon prints one chain for the S180, CMXGSAMY421S and CMXGSAMCX4218: 18″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links (S62).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman S180, CMXGSAMY421S and CMXGSAMCX4218 on one line with chain S62: 18″ bar, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The S185 is a different model and has its own page. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S62 under S180, CMXGSAMY421S and CMXGSAMCX4218: 18″ bar, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
